messages:
rita (new hire): hi everyone, quick onboarding question — i made a personal checklist for my first week (tasks, logins, meetups). where should i keep it in Notion so it's easy to share with my manager? also i don't see a template for the 'first-week checklist'.

ben (DevEx): welcome rita! :wave: put personal stuff under your `Private` space by default. if it's something your manager needs to track, create it under /Company Home/Onboarding/People Ops Checklists and link it to your team page.

rita (new hire): got it. any guidance on sharing permissions? I want my manager to edit but others read-only.

claire (Docs Owner): for sure. Use page permissions: add your manager with `Can edit` and the team group with `Can view`. If the manager isn't in Notion yet, ping people-ops-bot to add them. Also we have a lightweight template named "First Week - Personal Checklist" under /Company Home/Templates/Onboarding that you can copy.

rita (new hire): thanks — when I try to duplicate the template it prompts me to request access.

people-ops-bot: To request Notion edit access, open https://redwood.internal/access-requests and include the Notion page URL and your role. People Ops and Docs review during business hours.

claire (Docs Owner): I approved a copy for you this morning, rita. Try duplicating again; if it still fails, DM me the page link and i'll manually share a copy.

rita (new hire): duplication worked. couple extra Qs: 1) do we track completion anywhere centralize (People Ops wants a record), 2) any metadata to add to the page for audits?

ben (DevEx): good questions. 1) For central tracking, include a link to the completed checklist on /Company Home/Onboarding/Completed-Onboards and the manager should add the `Onboarded` date property. 2) Add these page properties: Owner, Team, StartDate, CompletedDate, Manager, Confidentiality (public/team/private). We use `TemplateID` if you copied from a canonical template.

rita (new hire): perfect. i'll copy the template into my Private space, fill it in, then move a published link to the completed list when my manager signs off. thanks! :smile:

claire (Docs Owner): thanks rita — if you want a quick walkthrough on the template (bulk rename, properties, automation), i'm happy to jump on a 15-min call.

rita (new hire): that'd be super helpful — i'll grab a slot.

people-ops-bot: Note: If you later need to transfer page ownership, submit an access request with page URL and new owner.
